lines.text: Here's how to use Swift Grab, the download manager for Windows.
Click any download link in your browser. Swift Grab takes over, and asks where to save it.
lines.cap: Click a download in your browser → SwiftGrab takes over

lines.text: Press Start Download. It splits the file into parts, so it finishes faster.
If your Wi-Fi drops, just press Resume. It picks up right where it stopped.
And every file lands in the right folder: video, music, documents, and more.
Try it free for thirty days, at get swift grab dot com.
